messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P1] Canary rollout failing for model rwd/instruct-3b@v4.3. Degraded responses and 5xx spike in hosting region us-west-2. Detected at 2026-03-15T09:07:36Z

raj_oncall: paging @anne_sre @mike_ml — I'm on the alert. seeing 12% 5xx over the last 5m, RTT up ~70ms

anne_sre: on it. grabbing logs, will check canary pool first

mike_ml: fyi we pushed v4.3 canary last night, small architecture tweak + quant profile. canary traffic = 10% of prod

tina_prodops: contacting affected customer-facing routes, estimated impacted users ~3% of calls, some retries causing higher latency

sam_support: opened ticket #SUP-4123 from key customer (acme) reporting hallucinations and hangs. linking here: https://support.internal/s/4123

anne_sre: quick dump from ingress errors:
```
2026-03-15T09:07:20Z ERROR handler.go:142 request_id=abc123 model=rwd/instruct-3b@v4.3 kv_cache_miss=true grpc: error code 13: transport is closing
2026-03-15T09:07:22Z ERROR runtime.go:87 gpu-mem alloc failed: out of memory trying to allocate 256MB
```

mike_ml: OOMs look suspicious. but the diffs in canary suggest larger context length usage — any prompt changes? Also we have new fused-kernel in v4.3 that allocs scratch buffers.

raj_oncall: can someone post canary vs prod metrics (latency/error) for 09:00-09:10?

anne_sre: from grafana: canary error rate 12.3% / prod error rate 0.6%. p90 latency: canary 420ms / prod 150ms. CPU/GPU mem churn higher on canary nodes

mike_ml: hypothesis 1: quant/kernel change increases transient memory usage under certain prompt patterns (longer prefixes). Hypothesis 2: batching change misaligned with new kernel -> bigger per-batch mem

tina_prodops: impact assessment: 3% of global requests, but high-value customers ~1 of top 10 affected -> potential revenue/SL impact. recommend immediate mitigation: pin traffic back to v4.2 and drain canary

anne_sre: agree. planned action:
- scale canary down to 0% traffic
- pin router to v4.2 for all routes
- collect full traces and kernel debug logs

deploy-bot: Received command: `rollout set-traffic --model rwd/instruct-3b --version v4.3 --percent 0 --reason "emergency rollback"`

deploy-bot: Executing gate: unroute canary. 3 canary pods draining...

raj_oncall: I'm going to reroute canary now: `./infra/route.py --model rwd/instruct-3b --from v4.3 --to v4.2 --percent 100`

anne_sre: drain complete. verifying traffic now.

mike_ml: note: before we fully rollback we should snapshot a canary node for heap/profile. can someone capture `nvidia-smi -q` and `pmap` of the runtime process? I'll prepare debug script

sam_support: notified customers via status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1782300456 :eyes:

anne_sre: after pin, errors dropped to 0.8% within 90s. p90 back to 160ms. marking mitigation successful :thumbsup:

tina_prodops: documenting mitigation and timeline in RCA thread. assigning follow-up action: root cause analysis with ML + runtime teams. target: 24h post-incident

mike_ml: I'll reproduce locally with long prefix prompt set and the new fused kernel. attaching pseudo-repro snippet:
```
# reproduce workload
python run_repro.py --model rwd/instruct-3b --version v4.3 --prompt-file long_prompts.txt --concurrency 8
```

anne_sre: collecting logs, saved archive: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1782300456/logs.tar.gz

raj_oncall: handing off to @anne_sre for RCA 2nd shift — I'm back on-call at 15:00 UTC

anne_sre: acknowledged handoff. I'll coordinate timeline and hypotheses here. Next steps:
- kernel memory audit
- run canary in isolated replica with instrumentation
- validate quant profile against v4.2 outputs

mike_ml: potential immediate code action: guard allocations in fused kernel and add a soft cap. will open PR with tests.

deploy-bot: Note: pinned version v4.2 across all regions. Route policy updated at 2026-03-15T09:09:37Z

sam_support: update: customer acme notified and happy with rollback. keeping ticket open for RCA

anne_sre: saving this thread to incident tracker. adding labels: canary-rollout, memory, rollback

mike_ml: adding hypothesis checklist: [kernel-allocation-bug, batch-sizing-change, dataset-long-prefix]

tina_prodops: timeline draft:
- 09:06:43 alert triggered by anomaly detector
- 09:07:36 on-call paged
- 09:08:10 canary scaled down command issued
- 09:09:37 rollback/pin completed
- 09:10:55 metrics recovered

anne_sre: assigning owners for RCA items: kernel bug (mike_ml), runtime batching (anne_sre), repro harness (mike_ml), customer comms (sam_support), postmortem writeup (tina_prodops)

mike_ml: I'll include canary diffs (input/outputs) and a checksum comparison tool to verify behavioral regressions

tina_prodops: thanks team. we'll keep this thread the source of truth for follow-ups. :lock:

incident-bot: Incident 1782300456 mitigation completed. Severity: P1 -> P1 mitigated. Please follow the RCA template at https://wiki.redwood.ai/incident-rca
